Name: Sign Venue Contract and Confirm AV Recording
Description:
Diego to get the convention center contract through legal review and signed by end of next week. The revised quote is 18,000 for the main hall plus two breakout rooms. Diego must confirm the AV package includes recording in all three rooms, as last year the breakout talks were lost because recording was main-hall only.

Steps to reproduce:
1. Route the venue contract to legal review.
2. Confirm in writing that the AV package includes recording in all three rooms (main hall + 2 breakouts).
3. Obtain signature on the contract by end of next week.

Acceptance Criteria:
- Venue contract is fully signed by end of next week.
- Written confirmation that AV recording is included for all three rooms.

Description:

- Lineup is locked within two weeks to allow agenda printing.

Name: Draft Three-Wave Email Campaign
Description:
Diego to draft an email campaign in three waves this month to boost registration (currently 340 against a target of 600).

Name: Same-Day Handoff of Speaker Bios and Headshots
Description:
Bo to hand the speaker bios and headshots straight to Diego for the landing page update the same day the lineup locks. The website needs the speaker pages before wave one of the email campaign.

Name: Approve and Place Swag Order
Description:

Steps to reproduce:

2. Camille approves the design proofs.
3. Diego places the swag order (800 shirts, 500 notebooks, 1,000 stickers) this week.

- Diego places the swag order this week.
